product_updates.title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
product_updates.content: OpenAI has reportedly raised an additional $11 billion as part of a funding round that hasn't closed yet but is expected to in the coming weeks.

product_updates.title: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web
product_updates.content: Security researchers found hundreds of servers hosting the penetration testing tool Artex exposed to the internet, allowing anyone access to the hacking tool.

product_updates.title: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent
product_updates.content: Meta's Muse agents continue to get new features and integrations. Spaces promises to be a new way to interact with the AI helpers.

product_updates.title: How a Blue Wave midterm might reshape the AI industry

product_updates.title: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
product_updates.content: AI usage keeps climbing, but spending has stalled. Price cuts and smarter cost controls among the biggest spenders could challenge investor assumptions about AI hypergrowth.

product_updates.title: After blocking Muse, Amazon now lets users text Alexa to help them shop
product_updates.content: Amazon said that the feature will roll out to millions of users in coming weeks.

product_updates.title: Underdog shows off a 32MB speech model in new demo
product_updates.content: Despite its small size, Underdog's new model can generate both speech and music.

product_updates.title: Physicl raises $10M to make the digital world real enough for robots
product_updates.content: Physicl is trying to solve the sim-to-real gap with a pipeline originally built to market goods online.

product_updates.title: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M
product_updates.content: Clutch, backed by Lightspeed and SignalFire, was last valued at $85 million, according to a source.

technical_breakthroughs.title: Chainalysis says hackers stole credentials and tokens for all of its customers
technical_breakthroughs.content: Company said a "multifront cyberattack" included AI agents and an on-path data snatch.
